sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Generate sites in Gemini Notebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>To get a richer understanding of your sources, you can transform them into interactive sites, such as dashboards, work tools, and visual narratives in Gemini Notebook.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Usage limits apply to creating sites. <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/17670842" rel="noopener">Learn more about Gemini Notebook usage limits.</a></p>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>This feature is only available to users ages 18 or over.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><h2>Generate a site</h2>

<p><strong>Important:</strong> To generate or delete a site, you need edit access to a notebook.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to&nbsp;<a href="https://notebook.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">notebook.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Select a notebook. You can:
    <ul>
      <li>Open an existing notebook that you have edit access to.</li>
      <li>Create a new one and upload sources. <a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16215270" rel="noopener">Learn how to add or discover new sources for your notebook.</a></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>In the "Chat" panel, ask to “make a site” along with a description of what you want to build, such as an interactive dashboard or project management tracker.
    <ul>
      <li>Gemini Notebook may take some time to generate your site. You can continue working in your notebook in the meantime.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>Interact with a site</h2>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>On shared sites, all users, including site owners, see only their own site inputs. They do not see any of the inputs other users make to the shared site.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to&nbsp;<a href="https://notebook.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">notebook.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Open the notebook that your generated site is in.</li>
  <li>In the “Studio” panel, select a generated site.&nbsp;
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip:</strong> To open a site in full screen, in the “Studio” panel, next to the site, select More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Open in new tab</strong>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Interact with your data through the site's custom features.
    <ul>
      <li>Your site saves &amp; reopens to the same selections and inputs you previously made, such as checking boxes, logging notes, or inputting text fields.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2>Share a site</h2>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>To share sites publicly and manage access, you must have a consumer account and be a notebook owner or editor.</p>

<h3>Share a link to the site</h3>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to&nbsp;<a href="https://notebook.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">notebook.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Open the notebook that your generated site is in.</li>
  <li>In the “Studio” panel, next to the site, select More <span id="cke_bm_7182S">&nbsp;</span><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Share</strong>.</li>
  <li>Make sure the notebook is shared with the recipient or with <strong>Anyone with a link</strong>. Viewers must have access to the full notebook.
    <ul>
      <li><a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16322204" rel="noopener">Learn how to use public notebooks &amp; featured notebooks in Gemini Notebook.</a></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>To get a shareable link, select <strong>Copy link to artifact</strong>.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Save</strong>.</li>
</ol>

<h3>Download the site</h3>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to&nbsp;<a href="https://notebook.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">notebook.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Open the notebook that your generated site is in.</li>
  <li>In the “Studio” panel, next to the site, select More <span>&nbsp;</span><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Download</strong>.</li>
  <li>Share the downloaded file.</li>
</ol>

<h2>Delete a site</h2>

<p><strong>Important: </strong>If you delete or turn off sharing to a site, previously generated share links will no longer work.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your device, go to&nbsp;<a href="https://notebook.google.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">notebook.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Open the notebook that your generated site is in.</li>
  <li>In the “Studio” panel, next to the site, select More <span>&nbsp;</span><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY=h48" width="auto" height="24" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lmyLMVlybtumLP-U9VlZykxTq-d0MTx8fVMWgvTKX455RBhqN4XuW-dpVv107NuXviY"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Delete</strong>.</li>
  <li>Select <strong>Delete</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<h2>Related resources</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16215270" rel="noopener">Add or discover new sources for your notebook</a></li>
  <li><a href="/gemininotebook/answer/16322204" rel="noopener">Use public notebooks &amp; featured notebooks in Gemini Notebook</a></li>
</ul>
